keyPoints: Bhinn (fraction) ka matlab hai kisi poori cheez ka hissa — jaise 1/2 ka matlab aadha.
Upar wali sankhya ko ansh (numerator) aur neeche wali ko har (denominator) kehte hain.
Jodne-ghatane ke liye har same hona chahiye: 1/4 + 2/4 = 3/4.
Har alag ho to pehle LCM se har same banao: 1/2 + 1/3 = 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6.
Guna me ansh x ansh, har x har: 2/3 x 3/4 = 6/12 = 1/2.
Bhaag me doosre bhinn ko palat kar guna karo: 1/2 / 1/4 = 1/2 x 4/1 = 2.
Tulna ke liye cross-multiply karo: 2/3 aur 3/4 me 2x4=8 < 3x3=9, to 3/4 bada hai.
Har bhinn ko simplest form me likho: 4/6 = 2/3 (common factor hatao).
Bhinn ko decimal me badalne ke liye ansh / har: 3/4 = 0.75.
Rozmarra me: aadha kilo = 1/2 kg, pauna ghanta = 3/4 hour.
